replacement_paths.dns: Operators address hosts by IP or their own resolver. No DNS vendor is required.
replacement_paths.identity: Invited accounts stay on an account service the operator runs. No identity vendor is required. Custody of recovery keys is still an open decision.
replacement_paths.media_storage: A provider agent stores bytes on its own disk. No object-store vendor is required. Public IPFS is not enabled.
replacement_paths.search: Discovery is the in-process index from goal 22. An operator can replace that process. No search vendor is required.
replacement_paths.transaction_access: An operator reads CometBFT on a validator they run, or runs the broadcaster. No gateway is required.
